title: Phase F: complementary held-out fold for the corruption-aware calibration intervention (frozen 2026-09-25, before any fold-2 run)
motivation: Fold 1 (nn_corruptcalib_v1_20260924) calibrated on gaussian_noise+jpeg and held out fog+motion_blur. Reviewers flagged the single direction as the weakest inferential link. Fold 2 swaps the roles.
hypothesis: If clean-only calibration ranges drive the RetinaNet matched-INT8 fragility, calibrating on fog+motion_blur should yield a corruption-specific gain on the never-calibrated gaussian_noise+jpeg family.

calibration.output_encoding: JPEG quality 95, subsampling 0 (identical to fold 1 and to evaluation caches)

decision_rules.primary: int8-cc2calib512 minus int8-matched512 on the fold-2 held-out mean (gaussian_noise+jpeg), paired bootstrap B=2000, same seed namespace as Phase B: CI95 excluding 0 => fold-1 frozen criterion replicated on fold 2
decision_rules.corruption_specific: Delta E held-out = (held-out difference) - (J95 clean difference) for int8-cc2calib512 minus int8-matched512 and minus int8-q95calib512: CI95 excluding 0 on the positive side => corruption-specific transfer supported; otherwise not supported
decision_rules.reporting: both rules are reported for both datasets regardless of outcome; fold-2 results are added to the manuscript whichever direction they point
